All necessary information has been gathered.

The premise is incorrect. Webhook delivery does not use NATS or RabbitMQ. It uses an in-process buffered Go channel. Four worker goroutines run in `init()` inside `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. The queue is declared as `asyncPostQueue` with capacity 128. `PostAsync` enqueues payloads. Dispatch is triggered from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`.
